Nepal Seeks Climate Compensation Amidst Flood Damage

Nepal is seeking international climate compensation following devastating floods on August 26, which caused an estimated $4 billion to $5 billion in damage. The disaster impacted key sectors like tourism and hydropower. Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah is set to raise the issue of climate compensation at the UN General Assembly. Activist Greta Thunberg has supported Nepal's call, stating the world owes the country "climate debt" rather than aid.
